items.description: get the best of both worlds in this dual seafood set that combines the rich flavours of stingray and sotong, drenched in an umami spicy sauce. Set includes rice, a fried egg and vegetables.

items.name: BBQ Spicy Sotong & Prawn Set for one 单人叁巴苏东和虾套餐

items.name: BBQ Spicy Stingray & Prawn Set for one 单人烧烤魔鬼鱼和虾套餐
items.description: juicy grilled prawns meets the aromatic barbecue of the stingray. Have this unforgettable combination drenched in a savoury sambal sauce. Set includes rice, a fried egg and vegetables.

items.name: BBQ Stingray 叁巴魔鬼鱼
items.description: find the perfect balance between the hardcore char of the grill and the tantalising spice of the sambal sauce in this dish. Paired with the sweet, flaky stingray, this dish is sure to hit the spot.
